name: Kyoga
source:
Werewolf - Wolf Demon

Weakness: The smell of fabric softener

"I'll save you, but you owe me a kiss."

Kyoga's flirty nature belies the seriousness of his true feelings for you.

"Are you scared of me? Too bad, I just can't resist you..."

Shinra: "He may seem like a playboy, but Kyoga is a gentleman."
Yukinojo: "He looks like a slacker, but he's actually really passionate and genuine."

[From [url=https://voltageapps.com/love365/apps/enchanted-in-the-moonlight/]English official site[/url]]
